outlook.statement: The Company is looking into enter the mass segment, which had not been fully explored by the Company till date.

The future for the Indian textile industry looks promising, buoyed by both strong domestic consumption as well as export demand. With consumerism and disposable income on the rise, the retail sector has experienced rapid growth. The Company is trying to come up with new products and ranges of inner wears according to changing consumer needs and demand. The Company has taken a step to evolve in the super-premium segment of innerwear.

risks: Many major international apparel brands have commenced operations in India realizing that Indian markets are likely to emerge as one of the largest markets in the world in the next few decades. Competitive intensity is expected to sustain high.

Availability and Rising Cost of Labour: Industry growing fast in highly labour intensive sector; demand for experienced and trained manpower outstripping supply. Company has created long term plans to motivate employees and set up robust training centers.

Increase in input and brand-building costs: Availability of raw materials at reasonable rates is a main concern. Company confident increases can be passed to consumers due to strong pricing power of brands. Also taking steps to monitor and improve productivity. Challenges for achieving Brand Reach and delivering effective communication rising disproportionately in fragmented media environment; Company planning and executing media campaigns with higher efficiency.
